pages.title: Quantum Field Lattice
pages.text: A field spread throughout spacetime, with particles appearing as quantised excitations of it. Every electron in the universe is a ripple in a single electron field. The lattice glows faintly and seems to ripple when breathed on.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Placing wave packets and spinors onto a differential manifold and cooling them in a condensate, I found the Analytic Continuator could describe them all as excitations of one field.
